subtitle: A concealment test battle.
briefing: Captain Boots leads the patrols into a contest for Pine Hamlet, Moss Hamlet and Fern Hamlet. Control all three villages at once, or defeat the opposing leader. You lose if your leader falls or the opposing army controls all three villages. Both armies can recruit from their keeps. Use your lantern bearers to expose ghosts. New recruits must stay near a bearer to see through the darkness.
hints: Use your lantern bearers to expose ghosts. New recruits must stay near a bearer to see through the darkness.
Villages fund recruitment. Keep your leader on a keep to recruit onto adjacent empty ground.
A captured village must remain yours: losing it makes its objective incomplete again.
debrief: The contest for the three villages is over.
